messages:
Anna L: Heads-up — started a 1% canary for redwood-v2p0-int4 on /generate (route A). quick FYI: initial perf looks ok but i'm seeing a small uptick in duplicate/near-duplicate endings on the docs-summarize slice.
Matt G: link to the dashboard? :eyes:
Anna L: https://redwood.alerts/graphs/abcd snapshot. p50/p95 match baseline, p99 about +120ms. duplicate rate on slice 'legal-briefs' +0.8% absolute.
Tariq: what's our auto-fallback rule atm? thought we used >1.5% dup OR quality delta >1%?
Eva S: current rollout config: fallback if abs_quality_delta(ROUGE-L) > 1.2% OR latency_p99 > 200ms OR error_rate_inc > 0.5%. see /configs/rollout.yml
Anna L: can we temporarily tighten for this canary? legal-briefs is high impact — propose OR threshold set to 1.0% abs for ROUGE-L and p99 >150ms for the next 2 hours.
Matt G: 👍 also recommend increasing shadow sample and running a replay of recent requests. and check kv-cache key hashing — seen misindexing with some quant variants before.
Tariq: kicking off replay now — will replay ~1k historical requests against baseline + variant, compare outputs. posting diffs in ~10m.
ci-bot: rollout-bot: canary redwood-v2p0-int4 started at 1729009999, routes=["/generate"], size=1%, policy=gradual
Anna L: thanks. if replay confirms regressions >1.0 ROUGE-L abs drop on any critical slice we auto-fallback. i'll patch the live rollout config to those temporary thresholds.
Eva S: note from quick local eval: slight tokenization offset on long contexts with this quantized kernel — looks like a prefix shift in some cases, could cause dedupe signatures. filing a postmortem ticket.
Matt G: replay diff example:
```
baseline: "...the court held that the plaintiff..."
variant:  "...the court held."
# variant truncated/duplicated punctuation leads matcher to consider it duplicate
```
Tariq: replay completed — summary: legal-briefs slice shows 1.3% ROUGE-L drop and a 0.9% absolute increase in duplicate endings. latency delta matches Anna's numbers.
Anna L: that's above our temp 1.0 threshold — i'm rolling back variant on route A now. will monitor for secondary effects.
ci-bot: rollout-bot: rollback executed for redwood-v2p0-int4 on /generate at 1729010200 by @Anna L
Eva S: opening ENG-RUNTIME ticket: tokenizer alignment + quant rounding investigation, assigning to @Tariq and @Matt G.
Matt G: also adding a preflight harness check for prefix consistency / dedupe-rate so future canaries fail fast.
Anna L: agreed. follow-up plan: fix tokenizer/quant mismatch, run 24h 100% shadow + replay validation, then gradual re-onboard with conservative thresholds.
Tariq: noted. i'll attach replay artifacts and target traces to the ticket.
Anna L: thanks all. long-term: consider adding a small behavioural-stability gate (dedupe/shortening) to the automated signals set.
